The '''species of [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[reptoid]]s''' from the depths of the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]] had long-vanished before the formation of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="SM">''[[Luke Skywalker and the Shadows of Mindor]]''</ref> Known members of the extinct reptilian race included the [[Kanzer Exiles]], a fanatical flock led by the [[Lord Ravager]] [[Korman Lao]].<ref name="UR">''[[The Unknown Regions]]''</ref> Lao’s group worshipped [[Demon/Legends|demons]]<ref name="SM" /> and claimed that they had been able to mentally enslave many minds at once.<ref name="BS">''[[Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
In ''[[The Unknown Regions]]'' sourcebook, the name «Kanzer Exiles» was written with capital letters, but later, when referring to the group, the word “exiles” was written in lowercase. This orthographic detail suggested that the group’s followers might indeed have been exiled from somewhere.
